loop.top3_series_pattern: trend_dominated, weak seasonality, non-stationary, moderate predictability, unstable model ranking across windows
loop.top3_why: The series is strongly trend‑dominated with little seasonal signal and exhibits unstable model rankings (Kendall tau 0.205). A robust, simple mean over the subset of models that maintain consistent ranking (pool1) is likely to generalize better than a weighted scheme that relies on high‑variance weight estimation from only three validation windows. The mean strategy also aligns with the diagnostic hint for a robust combination.
loop.top3_why_not: Candidate B, while having a marginally better validation score, uses a weighted scheme derived from a gradient‑boosted meta‑model trained on other series. With only three validation windows the weight estimates are highly variable and may overfit to the specific windows, risking poorer performance on the blind test. Candidate C, though a mean strategy, relies on a larger pool (pool2) that includes models with less consistent ranking, making it less robust to ranking instability and thus less likely to generalize.
